subject: HelioNow portfolio enablement & key stamping — rollout and amendment
messages:
From: Emma Stone <emma@helionow.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-09-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Help planning additional projects under our account

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the renewal paperwork last week — Raj and I reviewed the numbers and we
think HelioNow is ready to add 6 new projects (two internal tools, three customer-facing apps,
and one analytics batch job). Before we sign the amendment we want to confirm how you
handle multi-project provisioning, API key governance, and minimal-impact rollout.

A few quick questions:
- Can keys be namespaced per project and environment (prod/stage/dev)?
- How do you recommend isolating quotas so one app doesn't starve the others?
- What's the usual lead time for generating and rotating keys for 6 new projects?
- Do you offer a stamped naming template so our infra team can predict key names?

I've attached a rough project matrix (helionow_project_matrix.xlsx) with expected daily token
volumes per app. We have an upcoming product launch in late Oct and would like a staged activation
plan that minimizes developer friction.

Happy to hop on a quick call this week.

Best,
Emma Stone
Head of Platform
HelioNow

--
Attachment: helionow_project_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Stone <emma@helionow.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Help planning additional projects under our account

Hi Emma — great to hear HelioNow is expanding. Thanks for the matrix, that helps a lot.

Short answers up-front:
- Yes — we namespace keys by account:project:environment (example: HLN:billing:prod-2026-09).
  We call the predictable pattern "key stamping" internally and can provide a template.
- Quotas: we create per-key rate limits and a shared fallback pool. We'll propose per-project
  quotas based on your spreadsheet and also reserve a burst bucket for cross-app spikes.
- Lead time: generating keys and populating IAM / telemetry takes 48–72 hours for 6 projects if
  we have the final project names and owning contacts. For staged rollouts (preprod -> prod) add a
  1-week validation buffer.

I've sketched a recommended approach (attached inline) — a three-stage activation:
  1) Provision & stamp keys (namespaced)
  2) Pre-prod validation (autoscaling + KV cache warmup)
  3) Gradual cutover with monitoring/rollback hooks (48-hour canary windows)

Next steps I propose:
- Confirm canonical project IDs and primary owners (we'll create keys and metadata).
- Laura to run pre-prod test plan (I copied her).
- Ben to prepare an amendment (small per-key uplift for dedicated burst capacity) — Ben?
- Weekends for low-impact cutovers: suggest Sat 10/16 or Sun 10/17 (UTC windows negotiable).

Attachments: I've included a provisioning template (provisioning_template.json) you'll find easy to
fill with project IDs and owners. Also attaching the proposed amendment draft (proposed_amendment_v2.pdf)
for budget planning.

If that looks ok I'll book a 30-minute sync for Friday to walk through the plan.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: provisioning_template.json (template, 2KB)
Attachment: proposed_amendment_v2.pdf (PDF, 18KB)

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@helionow.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emma Stone <emma@helionow.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T13:29:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Help planning additional projects under our account

Thanks Karthik — this is useful. A couple of clarifications from our side before the sync:
- Audit: our security team requires proof that each key rotation is logged and that token-level
  usage is retained for 180 days. Can Redwood expose per-key usage logs to our SIEM (S3/CloudTrail
  export or a direct webhook)?
- Data residency: all production requests must be routed to us-east-1. Do you have a hard
  region pin for these keys?
- Pricing: is the per-key uplift fixed or tiered by aggregate token usage? For a rough budget
  number we'd need a sample calculation for 250M tokens/mo across the 6 new projects.

Also — small ask on naming: can the stamped key include a short project slug and a 6-char hash,
so our deploy scripts can pick keys deterministically? Example: HLN-analytics-prod-1a2b3c.

If you can attach the amendment that shows the tiered uplift, we can run it by procurement before
Friday.

Regards,
Raj Patel
Director, Infrastructure
HelioNow

- Per-project namespaced keys with "key stamping" pattern (HLN-<slug>-<env>-<6char>)
- Per-key quota partitions + a shared burst pool
- 180-day token-level retention; export to S3/CloudTrail or webhook to their SIEM
- Production routed to us-east-1 only

Karthik proposed timeline: 48–72h to provision keys once project IDs are confirmed + 1 week for
pre-prod validation. Target cutover: weekend of Oct 16–17.

  smoke tests for KV cache warmup and latency baselining. Target: complete by Oct 4.
- Ben — draft the amendment showing tiered per-token uplift and a dedicated burst add-on;
  include a sample calc for 250M tokens/mo split across 6 projects. Please share by EOD Thu.
- Karthik (me) — provision initial key stamps after HelioNow fills the provisioning_template.json;
  coordinate the cutover window and monitoring runbook.

Question for the team: for the 180-day retention requirement, do we propose the S3 export path or the
webhook delivery? My bias is S3 export + pre-baked Athena views for HelioNow to query. Thoughts?

I'll book a 30-minute sync Friday 9/4 at 10:00 PT to confirm owners and review Ben's draft.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
